panels.title: Request count per minute
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "api_request" | summarize requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,1m), tostring(signal.routeGroup)

panels.title: HTTP 5xx percentage
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "api_request" | summarize requests=count(), errors=countif(toint(signal.status)>=500) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m) | extend errorPercent=100.0*errors/requests

panels.title: HTTP p95 latency, milliseconds
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "api_request" | summarize p95Ms=percentile(todouble(signal.durationMs),95) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.routeGroup)

panels.title: HTTP authorization denial symptoms
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "api_request" and toint(signal.status) in (401,403) | summarize denials=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.routeGroup)

panels.title: HMAC correlation drilldown
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where isnotempty(signal.correlationHash) | project TimeGenerated, event=tostring(signal.event), correlationHash=tostring(signal.correlationHash), routeGroup=tostring(signal.routeGroup), status=toint(signal.status) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100

panels.title: Native DB capacity and connection symptoms
panels.query: AzureMetrics | where ResourceId =~ "__POSTGRES_ID__" and MetricName in ("active_connections","connections_failed","cpu_percent","storage_percent") | summarize peak=max(Maximum), mean=avg(Average), total=sum(Total) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), MetricName

panels.title: Oldest observed eligible active message; bounded peek, unknown when none observed
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "broker_age_snapshot" | project TimeGenerated, ageSeconds=tolong(signal.oldestObservedActiveAgeSeconds), hasEligibleActiveMessage=tobool(signal.hasEligibleActiveMessage), observation=tostring(signal.observation), sampledMessages=tolong(signal.sampledMessages), truncated=tobool(signal.truncated)

panels.title: Bounded outbox pending-work sample
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "queue_snapshot" | project TimeGenerated, pendingSampled=tolong(signal.outboxPendingSampled), failedSampled=tolong(signal.outboxFailedSampled), ageSeconds=tolong(signal.outboxOldestAgeSeconds), truncated=tobool(signal.truncated)

panels.title: Processing retry outcomes per five minutes
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "job_failed" and signal.jobState == "RETRY_SCHEDULED" | summarize retries=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.jobType)

panels.title: Native broker active and dead-letter counts
panels.query: AzureMetrics | where ResourceId =~ "__SERVICE_BUS_ID__" and MetricName in ("DeadletteredMessages","ActiveMessages") | summarize peak=max(Maximum) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), MetricName

panels.title: Terminal processing outcomes
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "job_failed" and signal.jobState in ("FAILED","DEAD_LETTERED") | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.jobType)

panels.title: Oldest broker correlation HMAC; no message identifiers
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "broker_age_snapshot" and isnotempty(signal.oldestCorrelationHash) | project TimeGenerated, oldestCorrelationHash=tostring(signal.oldestCorrelationHash), ageSeconds=tolong(signal.oldestObservedActiveAgeSeconds) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100

panels.title: Sampler failures and heartbeat
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event in ("operational_snapshot_failed","queue_snapshot","broker_age_snapshot") | summarize samples=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.event)

panels.title: Provider p95 completed-call latency, milliseconds
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where (signal.event == "source_usage" and tostring(signal.operation) startswith "provider.") or signal.event == "ai_run_metrics" | extend durationMs=coalesce(todouble(signal.duration_ms),todouble(signal.durationMs)) | summarize p95Ms=percentile(durationMs,95) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.provider), tostring(signal.operation)

panels.title: Provider failed source receipts and rejected AI outputs
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where (signal.event == "source_usage" and tostring(signal.operation) startswith "provider." and signal.phase == "FAILED") or (signal.event == "ai_run_metrics" and signal.status in ("REJECTED","FAILED")) | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.provider), tostring(signal.operation)

panels.title: Recorded token source units
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event in ("ai_run_metrics","source_usage") | extend input=coalesce(tolong(signal.inputTokens),tolong(signal.input_tokens)), output=tolong(signal.outputTokens) | summarize inputTokens=sum(input), outputTokens=sum(output) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.provider)

panels.title: Committed monetary receipts by provenance; do not add billed to estimates
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "cost_recorded" | summarize usd=sum(todouble(signal.microUsd))/1000000.0 by bin(TimeGenerated,1h), tostring(signal.provenance)

panels.title: Authoritative admission denials
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "api_admission_denied" or signal.event == "job_admission_denied" | summarize denials=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.code)

panels.title: Storage adapter bytes; excludes direct SAS client egress
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event == "source_usage" and signal.operation in ("storage.read","storage.write") | summarize bytes=sum(tolong(signal.bytes)) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.operation), tostring(signal.phase)

panels.title: Asset processing outcomes by bounded source type
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event in ("job_finished","job_failed") and signal.jobType=="asset.process" | summarize successes=countif(signal.event=="job_finished"), failures=countif(signal.event=="job_failed") by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.sourceType)

panels.title: Reconstruction provider failed source receipts
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event=="source_usage" and signal.operation=="provider.reconstruction" and signal.phase=="FAILED" | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m)

panels.title: Publication HTTP 5xx symptoms, not a publication integrity audit
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event=="api_request" and signal.routeGroup=="publication" and toint(signal.status)>=500 | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m)

panels.title: External delivery processing failures
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event=="domain_processing_result" and signal.domain in ("webhook","email") and signal.failed==true | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.domain)

panels.title: Actual uniqueness violations and issuance-processing failures
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event=="credential_integrity_violation" or (signal.event=="domain_processing_result" and signal.domain=="credential" and signal.failed==true) | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), tostring(signal.event), tostring(signal.code)

panels.title: Credential HTTP failures, separately from domain anomalies
panels.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend signal=parse_json(Log_s) | where signal.event=="api_request" and signal.routeGroup=="credentials" and toint(signal.status)>=500 | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m)
